project_context.name: Shree Dental Lab
project_context.domain: Premium Dental Lab / B2B Healthcare SaaS
project_context.key_differentiators: Avoid generic medical blue. Emphasize premium red and gold. Mobile-first focus. Clean and uncluttered dashboard design.

primary.name: Primary Red
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, active states, key highlights, selected tooth on FDI chart. Use sparingly to maintain premium feel.

secondary.name: Deep Ruby Red
secondary.usage: Hover states for primary buttons, deep accents, borders.

background.name: Warm Ivory
background.usage: Main application and page background. Avoid pure white backgrounds for the body.

surface.name: Porcelain White
surface.usage: Cards, modals, forms, dropdowns. Must contrast with the Warm Ivory background.

accent.name: Champagne Gold
accent.usage: Badges, 'add 1 more unit to save' nudges, small button accents, success/premium indicators.

text_secondary.name: Muted Taupe Grey
text_secondary.usage: Subtitles, placeholder text, secondary information, table headers.

layout_elements.name: Charcoal Black
layout_elements.usage: Main navigation headers, footers, high-contrast dark sections. The logo should sit on this background.

rules: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for all headings to give a premium, established corporate look.
Use 'Satoshi' for body text and dashboard UI for excellent legibility.
For numbers, stats, and pricing tiers, ensure tabular numerals are used so they align perfectly.
Heading weights should be Medium (500) to Bold (700).
Body text should be 16px (text-base) with generous line height (leading-relaxed).
Small labels (e.g., tooth numbers, status badges) should use uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-wider, text-xs).

layout_and_spacing.container_spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for main sections. Avoid cramped dashboard layouts.
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Porcelain White (#FFFFFF) cards with rounded-xl or rounded-2xl corners, placed on Warm Ivory (#F8F5F0) background.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: Subtle, soft shadows. Use shadow-sm for default cards. For hover states, use shadow-md with a slight upward translation (-translate-y-1).
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Start with single-column layouts. Ensure the FDI tooth chart is easily tappable on mobile (touch targets >= 44px).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Use the 'Control Room' grid but with generous padding. Don't cram widgets. Rely on whitespace instead of harsh borders for separation.

buttons.primary: Background #B82024, text white. Subtle gold accent (e.g., gold icon or a thin gold bottom border/shadow). Rounded-full or rounded-xl.
buttons.secondary: Outline button. Border #7A6F6A, text #2B2B2B. Hover state changes background to ivory (#F8F5F0).

badges_and_status.premium_nudge: Background #C9A45C/10, text #C9A45C, border border-[#C9A45C]/20. Use for 'Add 1 more unit to save' banners.
badges_and_status.status_pills: Rounded-full, px-3 py-1, text-xs, font-medium, uppercase, tracking-wider. Map status to colors (e.g., Completed = Gold background, In Progress = Taupe, New = Red).

tooth_chart.interaction: Visual 4-quadrant FDI chart. Tappable SVG zones. Selected teeth highlighted in Primary Red (#B82024). Unselected teeth outlined in Muted Taupe Grey.
tooth_chart.mobile: Ensure quadrant sections stack logically or are legible on mobile.

forms.inputs: Solid #FFFFFF background, rounded-lg, 1px border of #7A6F6A/30. Focus ring in Primary Red (#B82024).

logo.description: Shree Dental Lab Logo (white/red on dark bg). Best used in the Charcoal Black header.

hero_backgrounds.description: Dental lab professional holding tube. Use with a #111111 overlay for the homepage hero.
Dental lab machine operation. Good for 'About' or 'Production' sections.

portraits.description: Confident male dentist in dental office.

products.description: Close up of perfect white teeth (Zirconia Crown proxy).

interactions_and_animations.hover_states: Cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with a softer, larger shadow. Buttons should slightly brighten or increase contrast.
interactions_and_animations.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out' for smooth micro-interactions.
interactions_and_animations.loading: Use a Champagne Gold or Primary Red spinner. Avoid generic blue spinners.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) and key data points (lifetime savings, prices) must include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case format reflecting their role. e.g. data-testid='dentist-login-submit', data-testid='fdi-tooth-14'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Add fontshare import to index.css and configure tailwind.config.js to use Cabinet Grotesk for sans/heading and Satoshi for sans/body.
Do not use generic blue anywhere in the application. Stick strictly to the defined color_system using arbitrary values like bg-[#B82024] or configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Build the dashboard components using Shadcn UI but heavily customized to fit the premium, rounded-card (rounded-2xl), Warm Ivory background aesthetic.
Implement the FDI tooth chart as a fully interactive SVG where clicking a tooth path highlights it in Primary Red (#B82024).
Ensure all dashboard pages are mobile-first, using stacking or horizontal scrolling for wide tables.
Include the logo in the Charcoal Black (#111111) header with proper padding.
